reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Governance keeping pace with AI
themes.definition: Governance of new spheres such as AI must keep up with their speed and scale, with new rules prioritising human dignity, alongside implementing the Global Digital Compact.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging AI governance to keep pace with technology or new rules for AI.
themes.exclusion: Misuse for terrorism or hate speech (use AI_CYBER_SECURITY/AI_DISINFORMATION).
themes.boundary_cases: References to implementing the Global Digital Compact also take AI_UN_ROLE; dignity-first rules may also take AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS.

examples.quote: The governance of new spheres of human activity, including artificial intelligence, the Internet and outer space, must keep up with the speed and scale
New rules should place human dignity as the priority.

themes.label: AI misuse for terrorism and incitement
themes.definition: AI and social media increasingly used for incitement, terrorist recruitment and hate speech, affecting cybersecurity and requiring international cooperation.
themes.inclusion: Passages on AI used for terrorist recruitment, incitement or hate speech, with cybersecurity effects.
themes.exclusion: Pure mis/disinformation without violent-extremism content (use AI_DISINFORMATION).
themes.boundary_cases: Lists combining terrorism and disinformation take both codes.

examples.quote: increasingly being used for incitement, terrorist recruitment and spreading hate speech, misinformation and disinformation, with adverse effects on cybersecurity

themes.label: AI spreading misinformation harming youth
themes.definition: AI spreading misinformation and disinformation, with young people as victims.
themes.boundary_cases: Youth victimisation may also take AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION if education remedies are discussed.

examples.quote: Many young people have fallen victim to those negative practices.

value.rationale: The Philippines calls for governance of AI that keeps pace and prioritises dignity, while Kuwait focuses on AI and social media misuse for terrorism, hate speech and disinformation requiring international cooperation.
